mapper.select: SELECT member_id, login_id, email, nickname, bio, CASE WHEN profile_image IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS profile_image_exists FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT profile_image FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT password FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET nickname = #{nickname}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE members SET password = #{encodedPassword}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE members SET bio = #{bio}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE members SET profile_image = #{imageData, jdbcType=BLOB, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.BlobTypeHandler}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.member_id, m.nickname, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.is_public, p.is_temp, p.created_at, p.updated_at, ( SELECT '/api/attachments/' || a.attachment_id || '/image' FROM attachments a WHERE a.post_id = p.post_id AND a.upload_type = 'THUMBNAIL' AND a.is_deleted = 'N' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS thumbnail_url, 1 AS is_liked, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.post_id = p.post_id AND b.member_id = #{memberId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_bookmarked FROM posts p JOIN members m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.is_deleted = 'N' AND p.is_temp = 'N' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.post_id, p.member_id, m.nickname, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.is_public, p.is_temp, p.created_at, p.updated_at, ( SELECT '/api/attachments/' || a.attachment_id || '/image' FROM attachments a WHERE a.post_id = p.post_id AND a.upload_type = 'THUMBNAIL' AND a.is_deleted = 'N' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS thumbnail_url, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_likes pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.post_id AND pl.member_id = #{memberId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_liked, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.post_id = p.post_id AND b.member_id = #{memberId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_bookmarked FROM posts p JOIN members m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.is_deleted = 'N' AND p.is_temp = 'N' AND p.is_public = 'Y' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.post_id, p.member_id, m.nickname, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.is_public, p.is_temp, p.created_at, p.updated_at, ( SELECT '/api/attachments/' || a.attachment_id || '/image' FROM attachments a WHERE a.post_id = p.post_id AND a.upload_type = 'THUMBNAIL' AND a.is_deleted = 'N' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS thumbnail_url, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_likes pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.post_id AND pl.member_id = #{memberId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_liked, 1 AS is_bookmarked FROM bookmarks b JOIN posts p ON b.post_id = p.post_id JOIN members m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE b.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.is_deleted = 'N' AND p.is_temp = 'N' ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
